integrity: An explicit integral chain argument establishes the lattice statement; the finite verification is supplementary rather than proof of the infinite family. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The ordinary homotopy splitting is not claimed equivariant. The proof concerns once-subdivided stars with at least three arms, not arbitrary trees or arbitrary spider lengths. The reference date is the first public date of the 2026 motivating tree-complex paper; older background is separately cited. Priority is subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Higher independence complexes of subdivided stars: homotopy types and integral symmetry
